scope: Month-aware service history in the existing API 510, API 570 and API 653 calculators; isolated API 653 post-repair bottom assessment.

existingCalculations.unchanged: Existing pressure, thickness, MAWP, corrosion and unit-conversion equations and material tables remain unchanged. Only elapsed-time derivation gains optional months.
existingCalculations.compatibility: Unknown months retain the previous year-only result; saved records without month fields load as unknown. Existing manual time overrides remain supported.
existingCalculations.dateConvention: Selected year/month uses elapsed calendar months / 12; the post-repair panel's full inspection dates use actual UTC calendar days / 365.25. Current month/year updates automatically.
existingCalculations.mobileUi: 16 calculator views checked with build February 2006 and previous inspection February 2024; at November 2026 expected periods are 20.75 and 2.75 years.
existingCalculations.liveComparison: Pre-deployment production API 570 piping result cards match the updated local app exactly with unknown months. Recorded in tmp/live-piping-parity.json.
existingCalculations.legacyBaseline: The August 2026 root-browser SHA baseline already differs from the pre-task source for index.html and scripts.js. Root-browser files were restored byte-for-byte to pre-task backups. No baseline hashes or engineering tables were replaced. The material verification tool now ignores CRLF versus LF; all 61 material specifications match.

tolerance: Absolute 1e-10 for golden engineering values; 1e-9 for browser decimal-year fields.
validation: npm test: existing and new mobile/engine tests

node tools/test-month-repair-browser.cjs: 16 actual component views, known and unknown months, add/delete patches, actual report download, light/dark, phone/tablet/desktop, keyboard focus and no overflow
limits: Regression checks verify the changed paths and specified inputs; they do not independently certify every possible engineering case. Post-repair supported intervals require the entered inspection, repair, lining and separate zone-review evidence.
